Reproduce, minimise, hypothesise — in that order, every time.
Fix the cause, not the ceiling — raising the limit is how debt collects interest.

//skills: icon = simple-icons slug, verified by `npm run icons` (a wrong slug fails loudly there rather than silently blanking a tile). abbr is the fallback shown on phones.
//music: Track lengths are NOT written here on purpose — `npm run albumart` reads the real duration from the same iTunes lookup that fetches the cover, so the number can't drift from reality or be guessed wrong.
//starred: Deliberately empty. The section shows an honest empty state and switches to your real starred repos automatically once you've starred 2+ — no code change needed.
//guestbook: signUrl points at the live profile repo. The 'guestbook' label must exist there or signatures silently drop — see .github/workflows/guestbook.yml.
